scope: Read-only Kaggle MCP + browser score badges; no submissions, training, remote notebook runs, or model downloads.
files: raw/<author>__<slug>.json preserves MCP response; notebooks/*.txt extracts every source cell without executing notebook.
scores: raw/browser-score-evidence.json records visible first-party page badges and exact version links.

classification.official: Kaggle score badge / public leaderboard / team public submission
classification.self_reported: participant posts and notebook prose, even if their own experiments
classification.proposal: code or configuration without observed run result

limitations: No access to get_competition_submission metadata beyond public-safe listing.
Model search gemma-4 returned broad unrelated matches; absence of a model in this retrieval is not proof of nonexistence.
Latest notebook source and scored version are not interchangeable; score version links are recorded separately.
No claim of causality from unmatched budgets, hardware or single-run sweeps.
